- clarify console logs.

commit.message:
feat: add foreground service support (#60)

* feat: add foreground service support

* fix: start foreground service after successful connection restore

* refactor: return nothing from restore when no device is found

* fix: reset state after connection failure

- BUG: restore() left state on "connecting" when the connection failed, which blocked connect() until the app was restarted.
- clarify console logs.

* fix: deliver trigger alerts while app is in background

- enable useLegacyBridge so BLE messages reach JS in the background
- drop the 2s setTimeout in txHandle, which the WebView freezes. The debounce is now in the ESP32 code.

* Revert "fix: reset state after connection failure"

This reverts commit 39e6ec1cfcbfe9951f48e51f56b47e0f122bf8f3.

* Revert "refactor: return nothing from restore when no device is found"

This reverts commit 907510464939327c0e21973539297a214a5b76f7.

+import { LocalNotifications } from "@capacitor/local-notifications";
+
+export async function notifyLocal(
+	id: number,
+	title: string,
+	body: string,
+): Promise<void> {
+	await LocalNotifications.schedule({
+		notifications: [
+			{
+				id: id,
+				title,
+				body,
+				channelId: "alerts",
+				smallIcon: "ic_warning",
+				isExactNotification: false,
+			},
+		],
+	});
+}
